message.Title: Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB now integrates with Azure Advisor

Body.Content:
Azure HorizonDB now integrates with Azure Advisor to provide personalized recommendations that help you optimize your database environment. Azure Advisor analyzes your HorizonDB resources and surfaces actionable guidance to help improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency

Learn more.
